newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn goal of halving jobless achievable - spokesman.
newsitem.headline: Bonn goal of halving jobless achievable - spokesman.

text.p: Germany's goal of halving joblessness by the year 2000 remains achievable, government spokesman Peter Hausmann said on Thursday.

"This goal is ambitious. But it is achievable if (labour, management and government) each live up to their responsibility," Hausmann said in a statement commenting on unemployment data showing a slower rise in unemployment in February.
Fighting record unemployment remains Germany's most important challenge, Hausmann said.
The government's implementation of its Programme for More Jobs and Growth, launched a year ago, has fulfilled an important part of its tasks, he said.
Up to 30 billion marks in tax cuts included in the planned comprehensive tax reform will make a further contribution.

Hausmann called on management and labour to take seriously their responsibilities under the Alliance for Jobs plan, commit themselves to Germany as an investment target and exploit new opportunities for jobs creation, he said.
